before_open.what: Nvidia beat and $130bn Q4 guide lifted Nasdaq futures about 1.3% after hours
before_open.detail: NQ 27,365 at 02:30 AM PT; resistance 27,410-27,500 and 27,609.75; support 27,260-27,320; overnight low 27,093.

before_open.what: Reuters: Nvidia stops shipping US-approved AI chips to China; WSJ reports SEC probe of Nvidia
before_open.detail: Headline only; details not read. Trump is in China today.
First regular session after Nvidia's report; E-mini Nasdaq-100 futures hit a 7-month low on 17 Nov per CME.

top.headline: Nvidia beats and guides to $130bn, lifting Nasdaq futures; governance risks remain
top.why: Demand worries eased, but the rally has to survive the 6:30 AM PT cash open, with a reported SEC probe, a delayed 10-Q and the CEO search as open risks.
points: Q3 revenue about $116bn (+103% y/y) vs about $109bn expected; Q4 guided to $130bn plus or minus 3% vs about $125bn expected
NQ peaked at 27,609.75 after the report, fell to 27,093, then recovered to 27,365 by 02:30 AM PT; Nvidia about +3.4% pre-market
Board will not reinstate Huang; Heidrick & Struggles hired; WSJ reports an SEC probe; Bessent wants board answers within 10 days
10-Q not yet filed with results; due by early December
top.next: US cash open 6:30 AM PT today; 10-Q due early December; Bessent's 10-day deadline (about 27 Nov).

top.headline: Trump lands in China as Xi pushes open trade and Putin attacks sanctions
top.why: Any trade or chip-export signal from Trump-Xi talks feeds straight into tariff expectations and Nasdaq. Putin's presence at the same summit adds a Russia angle.
points: AP, 18 Nov: Trump arrives in China; Xi says Asia-Pacific needs open trade
Putin condemned sanctions at the same event, per AP
AP describes Trump as betting on 'unscripted diplomacy' with Xi and Putin
Reuters, 18 Nov: Nvidia has stopped shipping US-approved AI chips to China
top.next: Trump-Xi talks during the China visit; no dated outcome yet in sources.

top.headline: GTA VI reviews land ahead of Thursday launch: near-universal acclaim from major outlets
top.why: The embargo has lifted and early scores and write-ups from IGN, Guardian, VGC and others are strongly positive, which supports the launch and Game of the Year narrative.
points: IGN calls it 'one of the most impressive games ever made' after 100+ hours; VGC calls it 'the game of the generation'.
The Guardian praises the detailed world and the Jason and Lucia love story; VICE calls it Rockstar's 'magnum opus'.
Critics single out the open world and story; reviews are from outlets given early access, so treat as critic opinion, not player reception.
GTA VI leads The Game Awards 2026 nominations, including Game of the Year (outlets differ on the exact count).
top.next: Launch on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S on Thu 19 Nov; The Game Awards on Thu 10 Dec (voting until 9 Dec, 6 PM PT).

stories.headline: Pochettino lands in Manchester as United boss; first match is Liverpool away on Sunday
stories.why: The handover is complete: Pochettino has left the USMNT after a final win and starts at Carrington today, with a Liverpool trip as his first test.
points: Pochettino's last USMNT game was a 2-0 win over Haiti on 17 Nov (8-0 on aggregate) in the Concacaf Nations League quarter-finals.
He flew by private jet straight to Manchester, landing around midday on Wednesday 18 Nov, and is expected at Carrington immediately.
On Manchester being 'blue': 'You will see. Give me time.' He signalled fitness and work rate as a priority.
FotMob/Opta data cited by SI has United 19th in the Premier League for total distance (112.5 km) and high-speed running this season.
stories.next: Liverpool v Man United, Sunday 22 Nov (first game in charge, per Yahoo Sports).

desks.name: World Affairs & Politics
desks.note: Several Reuters/AP items rest on headlines only (article pages could not be opened), so they are marked reported.

stories.headline: US outages and air-travel ground stop: cause still unknown as Congress presses officials
stories.why: A nationwide aviation shutdown with no identified root cause is a continuing political and operational story, and the cyber-attack question is still open.
points: Reuters, 17 Nov: Transport Secretary Duffy says the root cause of the aviation shutdown is not yet determined
AP, 17 Nov: FAA temporarily stops router installations connected to the air-travel stoppage
AP, 18 Nov: Rubio says there is 'zero' information that outages are linked or caused by a malign actor
AP, 18 Nov: Mullin goes to Congress today to face questions on flight disruptions, a football trip and immigration
stories.next: Mullin's congressional questioning today, 18 Nov.

stories.headline: Democrats flip 9 Senate seats, most in almost 70 years; Peltola beats Sullivan in Alaska
stories.why: Reshapes the Senate balance and puts pressure on Democratic leadership, with Schumer facing a Van Hollen challenge.
points: AP, 18 Nov: Democrats flipped 9 US Senate seats, the most in almost 70 years
AP called Alaska for Democrat Mary Peltola over incumbent Republican Dan Sullivan
AP, 17 Nov: Van Hollen's bid to replace Schumer as leader is pressing Democrats to take sides
Earlier thread note: secret ballot for leader expected in December
stories.next: Democratic leadership secret ballot, expected December (date not yet in sources).

stories.headline: EU proposes €45bn Ukraine loan for 2027, repayable only after Russia pays reparations
stories.why: Shows Europe planning Ukraine funding into 2027 even as talks remain unsettled; the repay-after-reparations design ties the loan to Russia's liability.
points: Reuters, 18 Nov: EU proposes a new €45 billion loan to Ukraine for 2027
To be repaid only after Russia pays reparations, per the headline
Thread context: trilateral-meeting idea still unsettled and escalation on both sides (17 Nov)
stories.next: Member-state response to the proposal; no date in sources.

stories.headline: UK inflation edges up to 3.6% in October on record fuel costs
stories.why: Inflation moving away from target keeps pressure on the Bank of England, which is at 4% and sees CPI near 5% by mid-2027.
points: ONS, 18 Nov: CPI 3.6% in October, up from 3.5% in September; +0.5% on the month
Motor fuels up 33.2% on the year, the largest annual rise since July 2022
Services inflation 3.7%; goods inflation 3.5%, highest since September 2023
CPIH 3.7% (from 3.6%); core CPI 2.8%
stories.next: Next Bank of England decision (date not in sources).

stories.headline: Australian wages grow 1.1% in the quarter, the strongest since late 2023
stories.why: Firmer wage growth adds to the case the RBA has been tightening on (cash rate 4.85% after five rises this year).
points: ABS, 18 Nov: Wage Price Index +1.1% in September quarter 2026, +3.5% annually
Annual growth was 3.4% a year earlier; peak was 4.3% in late 2023
Private sector +3.4% y/y; public sector +3.9% y/y
ABS cites the Fair Work Commission's 4.75% award rise as a key driver
stories.next: Next RBA decision (date not in sources).

desks.note: No watchlist-firm announcements in the feed; a Topstep search found only third-party explainers, nothing new from Topstep. Unconfirmed: Topstep November rule changes and country restrictions still rest on third-party trackers. ASIC AI-enforcement and NZ FMA items are regulator news for CFD/forex brokers, not prop firms.

stories.headline: TradingView adds tick-based Footprint, Volume Delta and CVD on the Ultimate plan
stories.why: Delta and CVD classified from real trade data rather than candle direction should be more trustworthy for futures order-flow work. It is gated to Ultimate, so check whether the cost is worth it for you.
points: TradingView blog post dated 13 Nov (updated 17 Nov); feature is off by default and available on the Ultimate plan.
Trades are classified by exchange aggressor side first, then bid/ask comparison, then tick movement.
Aggressor data covers CME, CBOT, NYMEX, COMEX and EUREX futures plus major crypto venues.
Limits: timeframes up to 1D, up to 3 million ticks; incomplete data shows a warning or an error.
stories.next: No dated catalyst; watch TradingView release notes for wider plan availability.

stories.headline: OpenAI launches GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol, undercutting Claude on price on Anthropic's IPO eve
stories.why: Frontier agent pricing is dropping fast, and OpenAI's own cost-per-task claim against Claude Fable 5.2 lands just as Anthropic goes public. Independent testing shows a smaller gap than the headline.
points: Launched 17-18 Nov: Astra API price $8/$40 per million tokens (down 20%); Sol stays at $2/$10.
OpenAI claim: 78.3% on Agents' Last Exam at about $2.89 per task vs $60.05 for Claude Fable 5.2 (company benchmark, specified configuration; OpenAI notes 9 Fable tasks excluded).
Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index: Astra 62, Fable 5.2 65, Sol 57; Decrypt reports no gain in coding-agent performance.
Astra is OpenAI's first public model rated High for AI self-improvement; both models meet its Critical cyber threshold.
stories.next: Anthropic IPO trading begins Thu 19 Nov; watch for a Claude price response.

stories.headline: Anthropic IPO prices today, may top $80 a share; Nasdaq trading starts Thursday
stories.why: The biggest AI listing so far is a test of AI-bubble nerves after a sharp slide in Nvidia and other AI stocks. Strong demand versus a spooked market is the thing to watch.
points: Ticker ANT on Nasdaq; pricing expected 18 Nov ET, trading 19 Nov. Range $70-$78, WSJ-sourced reports say above $80.
Order book reported near 7x oversubscribed; valuation talk $1.5-1.6 trillion; raise targeted above $60bn (AP via SFist).
Claude run-rate revenue about $81bn against $900.9bn of compute commitments (TradingKey, from filings).
Amazon and Google to own nearly 30% post-IPO (TechCrunch); Nvidia reportedly buying $10bn of stock (AP via SFist).
stories.next: Final pricing 18 Nov; first trade Thu 19 Nov.

stories.headline: Anthropic opens Linked billing beta so app customers can pay for their own Claude usage
stories.why: If you build on the Claude API, you can now pass usage costs to the end customer per request instead of absorbing them. It makes resale and SaaS pricing simpler.
points: Beta launched 17 Nov; per request, bill_to: "user_profile" charges the linked customer, "self" charges the developer.
Execution stays in the developer's org, so the developer's rate limits and model access still apply.
Not supported for Message Batches or billable code execution; marketplace and subscription-billed orgs cannot be charged.
Harness and Tessera announced integrations the same day.
stories.next: Beta; no GA date given.

stories.headline: Instagram adds Amazon affiliate links to Reels and posts with no platform cut
stories.why: Creator-led product discovery now sits inside Instagram with a frictionless Amazon path, which helps affiliate-style content but may pull Meta ad budgets towards its own commerce funnel. DTC brands competing with Amazon listings should expect more creator links.
points: Creators link Amazon Influencer accounts and add affiliate links to Reels, feed posts and carousels.
Amazon still handles checkout; Instagram takes no commission.
Trade commentary says purchase attribution gives Meta better ad-targeting signal (opinion of agency founders).
Reported 17 Nov; no rollout schedule seen.
stories.next: No date; watch for rollout and Meta shopping ad changes.

stories.headline: Meta to remove placement, platform and device exclusions from ad sets
stories.why: Advertisers lose a basic brand-safety and efficiency lever; value rules become the workaround. Check which exclusions your campaigns rely on.
points: Meta is notifying advertisers it will remove the Placements option and exclusions by platform, device and OS (per Jon Loomer analysis via TechJuice).
No effective date announced.
Loomer's view: you can still solve placement problems using value rules.
Separately, one Meta ad can now carry up to 5 existing posts, with Meta picking per person (PPC Land, from an agency LinkedIn post; no Meta announcement cited).
stories.next: Effective date not announced.

stories.headline: Field test: Google AI Mode cut clicks to websites by 18.8 points
stories.why: Two randomised studies now point to fewer outbound clicks from Google's AI search, a risk to organic traffic for DTC and content sites ahead of Q4.
points: Preregistered experiment, 1,100 US users, one week in March 2026 (Penn and Northeastern; arXiv preprint, not peer reviewed).
AI Mode users clicked out 18.8 points less than standard Search and used Bing, DuckDuckGo and Yahoo more.
Limits: young, left-leaning sample; AI Overviews-removal estimate (+8.8 points) relies on a post-hoc adjustment.
stories.next: None scheduled.

stories.headline: Six arrested digging a 9m ancient cistern at Horvat Adash, a Second Temple-era site
stories.why: Looting of Judean sites destroys the stratigraphic context that biblical archaeology depends on. The IAA says social-media treasure stories are driving it.
points: IAA announced the arrests on 18 Nov; the group was caught last weekend in the Judean Hills digging in a cistern about 9m deep, while others sat by a bonfire as cover.
They had a generator, electric jackhammer, drilling gear and a ladder; ancient plaster layers were broken through.
Inspectors found hundreds of pottery fragments, stone vessels and part of an animal-shaped vessel dated to the Early Muslim period (7th-10th centuries).
Horvat Adash has remains from the Second Temple period to the early Muslim period; the offence carries up to five years in prison and prosecutors will decide on indictment.
stories.next: Prosecutors to decide on indictments once the police investigation ends (no date given).

stories.headline: YouVersion founder shelved a Bible-app chatbot over 'spiritual authority' fears
stories.why: A major Bible-app maker is publicly declining to make AI a spiritual guide, a useful marker for how AI and scripture are meeting.
points: Bobby Gruenewald told Christianity Today that people treat AI as a trusted 'oracle' and lose sight that it could be wrong.
YouVersion dropped a prototype with a chatbot, fearing it would be seen as a spiritual authority.
He flagged crisis situations such as suicidal thoughts, where people should be directed to human support.
He also fears subtle drift in Bible translations over a generation; he says he is not 'anti AI'.
stories.next: No dated catalyst.

stories.headline: Pope Leo in Peru: nations have done 'very little' since the 2019 Amazon synod
stories.why: Continues the Peru trip thread; adds an environmental theme to the earlier word on celibacy and unity.
points: RNS reports Leo mourned that 'very little has been done' seven years on from the 2019 Vatican Amazon gathering.
Climate change and its impact on the most vulnerable was a recurring theme of the trip, the first papal trip since that synod.
Detail comes from RNS summary only; full text not read.
stories.next: Remaining Peru trip events; no dated item in sources.

stories.headline: Retatrutide NEJM sleep apnea trials: placebo-adjusted gain about 24 events per hour
stories.why: The peer-reviewed numbers are more modest than Lilly's headline 60.6%, which did not say whether it was placebo-adjusted. The drug is unapproved and trials were Lilly-funded.
points: Non-diabetic trial (n=243): 51.6% on 9mg reached mild or no apnea at 80 weeks vs 12.5% placebo.
About 34 fewer events per hour on drug, about 10 on placebo, so roughly 24 net.
Diabetes trial (n=448): 39.5% on 9mg reached mild or no disease vs 12.6%; net reduction about 14-15 per hour.
Not approved for any use; not shown to replace CPAP.
stories.next: Regulatory timeline not confirmed in the source.
stories.study: Two phase 3 RCTs reported in NEJM, n=243 and n=448, adults with obesity and moderate-to-severe OSA; sponsor-funded, 80 weeks, secondary report via Medical Daily/Healio

stories.headline: Stopping GLP-1 drugs linked to about double the heart events in Italian diabetes cohort
stories.why: Relevant to anyone on or considering GLP-1s: stopping may carry cardiovascular cost, though this is observational and confounding is likely.
points: Lancet Regional Health Europe cohort: 301 Italian diabetes clinics, 2004-2024, matched groups of 28,713 each.
Heart attack, stroke or death: 3.94 vs 1.96 per 100 person-years after stopping vs staying on.
All-cause deaths: 2.23 vs 0.48 per 100 person-years; weight regain and glycaemic change were modest.
Type 2 diabetes only, no prior CV event; tirzepatide not included; unmeasured health factors may explain mortality.
stories.next: No dated catalyst.
stories.study: Retrospective cohort, 57,426 matched adults with type 2 diabetes in Italy; key limitation: observational, confounding by illness and reasons for stopping

stories.headline: Nature study backs Lancet 'clinical obesity' framework over BMI alone in 840,000 adults
stories.why: Supports moving from BMI to organ-function-based diagnosis, and suggests many with excess fat but no organ impairment rarely progress.
points: Four cohorts (China, Britain, US, Spain), over 840,000 adults.
BMI underestimated obesity in 5.2-8.6% of people and overestimated in 1.2-3.1%.
77-91% of preclinical obesity cases did not progress to clinical obesity over 10+ years in three cohorts.
Mortality risk rose 19% for preclinical and 69% for clinical obesity versus neither.
stories.next: No dated catalyst.
stories.study: Multi-cohort observational validation, 840,000+ adults; limitation: observational, based on press summary via Xinhua, not the paper

stories.headline: GTA VI launch-day strain: 212 GB download, ISP congestion warnings, PC only rumoured for Q1 2027
stories.why: If you are playing Thursday, expect network and server hiccups; PC players have no confirmed date.
points: Preloads opened 10 Nov for the 212 GB game; some ISPs said traffic spikes congested their networks (Polygon).
Rockstar staggered patches before launch to spread server load; Polygon expects day-one network problems are likely.
Rockstar has confirmed no PC version at launch; a GamesBeat report (anonymous sources) points to Q1 2027, which is unconfirmed.
The game unlocks at local midnight on 19 Nov, so New Zealand players start first.
stories.next: Unlock from local midnight 19 Nov (PT evening of 18 Nov for early time zones).

stories.headline: Voyager 1 reaches one light-day from Earth on 18 Nov
stories.why: A human-made object's signal now takes a full 24 hours to arrive, a vivid scale marker for a 49-year-old probe that is still returning interstellar data.
points: Nature says Voyager 1 reaches 25.9 billion km at 5:16 a.m. EST on 18 Nov, farther than any human-made object.
Launched in 1977, it left the heliosphere in 2012 and Voyager 2 followed six years later.
Instruments are being switched off to conserve plutonium power; Voyager 1 is expected to lose communications in 2029, Voyager 2 in 2031.
Still the only direct measurements of interstellar space, showing solar particle storms reach far further than expected.
stories.next: Voyager 1 comms expected to end around 2029.

updates.headline: FOMC minutes: some wanted an October hike; a couple float more than 25bp in December
updates.why: The minutes confirm the Fed leans towards further tightening, and the hike-supporter count was the main Fed read for rate-sensitive Nasdaq futures this week. Almost all participants saw further hikes as likely appropriate, so December is live.
points: October 27-28 meeting ended 10-2 to hold (Cook and Hammack dissenting); some participants favoured a 25bp hike and a few holders called it a close call
A couple of participants said a rise of more than 25bp could warrant consideration in December if inflation data came in unfavourable
Almost all participants judged further hikes likely appropriate; the vast majority saw upside inflation risks and many called the AI buildout a 'material source of inflation risk'
Per Investing.com's account, markets price about 27bp of hikes for December and about 62bp over the next three meetings
updates.next: December FOMC decision; next inflation data prints before it (date not confirmed in sources seen)

updates.headline: Iran widens Gulf attacks to a US air base in Kuwait and sites in Bahrain
updates.why: This takes the Gulf escalation on this morning's watch list beyond Bahrain to a US base in Kuwait, a live input for oil, shipping and risk sentiment. Detail is thin: the AP article could not be opened, so casualties and damage are unverified.
points: AP reports Iran fired on a US air base in Kuwait and at targets in Bahrain on 18 Nov
Separately, Reuters reports the US intelligence director saying threats from Iran have increased substantially
Reuters also reports (citing sources) an Israeli spy chief lobbied for joint Iran strikes on a US visit; unconfirmed beyond that headline
Casualties, damage and US response not confirmed in sources read
updates.next: US response and any oil or futures reaction at tonight's open; no scheduled date found
